title: Adventure (350-point version): expanded Colossal Cave
description: The expanded 350-point Woods version of Colossal Cave with full scoring, endgame, and all treasures. Same Tier 1 approach as the base Colossal Cave bead — graph nodes, perturber-driven puzzles, CEL constraints. More rooms, more objects, more complex state transitions, but still fundamentally data-driven. Score tracking via counters.
